title: Questionnaire Sketch A: quarter-arc for marking object elevation from observer's eye
description: Sighting questionnaire page (printed page 262) whose question 17 asks the witness to draw lines from the observer's eye to a circular arc to show the object's apparent elevation, labeling first sighting "a" and last sighting "b". The blank figure, captioned "SKETCH A", is a quarter-circle arc labeled "Directly Overhead" at top, "Horizon" at right and "Observer's Eye" at the corner. Questions 12-16 above cover sound, shape, color, size, motion, disappearance and facing direction.
